QuestInfo.name: Heart for Neo Huroid
QuestInfo.0: Humanoid A now has the #t4033849#. Help Humandoid A to produce Neo Huroid.
QuestInfo.1: The last item needed to build the Neo Huroid is the Mechanical Heart. Humanoid A wants to give up its own Mechanical Heart so that it can be placed in the #bNeo Huroid#k.
QuestInfo.2: Humanoid A stops moving after taking the Mechanical Heart but Neo Huroid starts to move immediately after the Mechanical Heart is placed in it.
